# De Gruyter Brill

> A leading academic publisher specializing in peer-reviewed open access and subscription journals spanning humanities, sciences, and social sciences.

De Gruyter Brill publishes over 20 active journals across diverse disciplines including linguistics, materials science, medicine, law, and education. The publisher is actively transitioning many titles to open access models while maintaining rigorous peer-review standards and archival preservation through partnerships like Portico.

## Key Topics

- peer-reviewed journals
- open access publishing
- academic journals
- linguistics research
- materials science
- life sciences
- German-language publications
- Creative Commons licensing
- Subscribe-to-Open model
- journal archives
- digital humanities
- crystallography
- agricultural sciences
- pain research
- legal studies

## Active Open Access Journals

- [Open Education Studies](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/edu/html): Open Access peer-reviewed journal publishing education research across all levels and disciplines.
- [Open Agriculture](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/opag/html): Open Access journal covering agriculture, sustainable development, and rural sciences.
- [Scandinavian Journal of Pain](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/sjpain/html): Open Access journal on pain research, mechanisms, and clinical management.
- [Comparative Southeast European Studies](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/soeu/html): Open Access multidisciplinary journal on Southeast European politics and society.

## Transitioning to Open Access

- [Zeitschrift für Kristallographie - Crystalline Materials](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/zkri/html): Transitioning to Gold Open Access, oldest crystallography journal since 1877.
- [Probus - International Journal of Romance Linguistics](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/prbs/html): Double-blind peer-reviewed journal on Romance linguistics transitioning to Open Access.
- [Journal of African Languages and Linguistics](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/jall/html): Transitioning to Open Access, established forum for African linguistics research.
- [Review of Law & Economics](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/rle/html): Peer-reviewed journal on law and economics transitioning to Open Access in 2026.

## Humanities & Language Studies

- [Digital Studies in Language and Literature](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/dsll/html): Peer-reviewed journal on digital technology, computational linguistics, and literary studies.
- [Lexicographica](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/lexi/html): Annual peer-reviewed yearbook on lexicography, dictionary-making, and computational linguistics.
- [Paragrana](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/para/html): International transdisciplinary journal on historical anthropology and Slavic studies.
- [Zeitschrift für Kultur- und Kollektivwissenschaft](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/zkkw/html): German-language peer-reviewed journal on cultural and collective science.

## Science & Technology Journals

- [HTM Journal of Heat Treatment and Materials](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/htm/html): Bilingual peer-reviewed journal on heat treatment and materials technology research.

## Law & Legal History

- [Jahrbuch der Juristischen Zeitgeschichte](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/jjzg-b/html): German-language annual publication on legal history and jurisprudence.

## Optional

- [Mathematics of Climate and Weather Forecasting](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/mcwf/html): Closed Open Access journal on mathematical methods in climate and weather forecasting.
- [Electrochemical Energy Technology](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/eetech/html): Closed Open Access journal on electrochemical energy storage and conversion.
- [Nanospectroscopy](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/nansp/html): Closed Open Access journal on nanospectroscopy and nanotechnology research.
- [Journal of international biotechnology law](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/jibl/html): Ceased publication journal on international biotechnology law (2004-2009).
- [Zeitschrift für Miet- und Raumrecht](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/zmr/html): Ceased German-language journal on rental and lease law (68 years).
- [Fractional Calculus and Applied Analysis](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/fca/html): Ceased publication journal on fractional calculus and mathematical analysis.
